description: Fix bugs and issues found in explore-mode code review: security, message persistence, frontend styling, error handling, and code quality improvements.

tasks.title: Fix path traversal boundary check in read-file tool
tasks.description: Fix the startsWith check in read-file.ts to include path separator boundary, preventing /projectA from matching /projectAB/file.txt.
acceptanceCriteria: read-file.ts path check uses startsWith(projectPath + path.sep) || resolved === projectPath
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Simple one-line fix in packages/cli/src/tools/read-file.ts line 34.

tasks.title: Add try/catch to grep-tool walkFiles
tasks.description: Add try/catch around readdirSync in walkFiles function in grep-tool.ts, consistent with globWalk in glob-tool.ts. Catch permission errors and continue silently.
acceptanceCriteria: walkFiles has try/catch around readdirSync
Permission-denied subdirectories do not crash the grep
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow the same pattern as globWalk in glob-tool.ts lines 54-57.

tasks.title: Refactor create-issue-tool to inject eventBus via context
tasks.description: Add eventBus to CreateIssueToolContext and pass it from createExploreRoutes, removing the direct singleton import. Update server/index.ts wiring.
acceptanceCriteria: create-issue-tool.ts imports eventBus type, not singleton
CreateIssueToolContext includes eventBus field
createExploreRoutes passes eventBus to the tool context
eventBus.emit call uses context.eventBus instead of imported singleton
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Follow add-comment.ts pattern which receives eventBus via context. Added eventBus: EventBus to CreateIssueToolContext, ExploreAgentContext, and createExploreRoutes signature. Wired through server/index.ts.

tasks.title: Fix explore-agent return type
tasks.description: Replace the 'any' return type of runExploreAgent with the actual streamText return type from the Vercel AI SDK.
acceptanceCriteria: runExploreAgent return type is not 'any'
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Used ReturnType<typeof streamText> as explicit return type. Removed any and eslint-disable comment.

tasks.title: Fix explore-service addMessage session validation and remove dead code
tasks.description: Add session existence check in ExploreService.addMessage. Remove unused touch() method from ExploreSessionRepo.
acceptanceCriteria: addMessage throws or returns error if session does not exist
ExploreSessionRepo.touch() method is removed
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Added session existence check in addMessage throwing Error if session not found. Removed unused touch() method from ExploreSessionRepo.

tasks.title: Fix explore API message persistence timing and issue ID
tasks.description: Move user message save to after agent succeeds, but include user message in agent history before calling agent. Capture issue number from create_issue tool result string via regex instead of re-reading from DB. Send issue number (not UUID) in done event.
acceptanceCriteria: User message is added to agent history before calling agent
User message is NOT persisted to DB before agent runs
Both user and assistant messages are persisted together only after successful stream completion
createdIssueId captured from tool-result when tool name is create_issue
Fallback to DB read if regex parse fails
done event issueId contains issue number string
On stream error or DB write failure, user message is not persisted and error is returned
Typecheck passes
tasks.notes: Moved user message persistence from before agent call to after success. Added user message to history in memory via spread. Fixed tool-result type access (part.toolName/part.input/part.output). Captured issue number from create_issue tool output via regex with DB fallback. Both messages persist only on success.

tasks.title: Fix frontend error handling and typography
tasks.description: Install @tailwindcss/typography@^0.6.0 for Tailwind v4 compatibility and add @plugin directive. Add streamError to useExploreStream hook. Display error in ExplorePage. Fix ExploreRedirect error handling.
acceptanceCriteria: @tailwindcss/typography@^0.6.0 installed in package.json
@plugin '@tailwindcss/typography' added to CSS entry file (index.css)
useExploreStream returns streamError state
streamError set on done event with error field and on stream catch
streamError cleared on new send() call
ExplorePage displays error banner when streamError is set
ExploreRedirect handles session creation failure
Build succeeds
tasks.notes: Installed @tailwindcss/typography@0.5.19 (0.6.0 not yet released). Added @plugin directive. Added streamError state to useExploreStream, set on done+error and catch. Added error banner in ExplorePage. Added onError handler and error display in ExploreRedirect. Build succeeds.
